name: Sallai
title: Benjaminite settler in Jerusalem
summary: Sallai (also spelled Sallu) was a Benjaminite among those who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in the lists of Nehemiah and Chronicles regarding those who took up residence in the rebuilt city. His presence testifies to the repopulation of Jerusalem following the exile.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem after the exile
keyEvents.description: Sallai was among the Benjaminites who settled in Jerusalem after returning from Babylon, as part of the repopulation of the holy city.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogical record of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Sallai (Sallu) is listed in the genealogy of Benjaminites living in Jerusalem, confirming his role in rebuilding the community.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jerusalem's new population
keyEvents.description: As part of Nehemiah's plan, one out of every ten Israelites was chosen to live in Jerusalem, and Sallai was among those selected to strengthen the city's population.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding Jerusalem's community
keyEvents.description: Sallais settlement in Jerusalem was part of the larger national effort to rebuild a functioning Jewish community around the temple and the reconstructed city wall.
